glosses: place where one sleeps, such as a bed or a spot in a barn, etc.
lair of an animal (but not usually underground, for which Bau)
camp (accommodation of tents or quickly built houses)

examples.text: Das Buch haben wir nicht auf Lager.
examples.en: We don't have that book in stock.
We hiked back to the camp.

examples.text: Wir werden hier unser Lager aufschlagen.
Wer hat vergessen, das Lager abzuschließen?
examples.en: Who was it that forgot to lock the door of the warehouse?
